trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap in order: finish the story, clear the stranger strands and side missions, then work through activities, collectibles and money goals, and finish with the 100% completion trophy. Nothing about the platinum itself is missable — it is a checklist of everything else.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); roadmap built from the official list.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission Gone Fishing. It is a story mission, so the game takes you to the fishing spot and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Unmissable: every playthrough reaches this mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Unmissable: chapters must be completed in order to reach the ending.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Unmissable: chapters must be completed in order.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Unmissable: chapters must be completed in order.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Unmissable: chapters must be completed in order.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It unlocks after Chapter 4, once every story thread is resolved. Unmissable: the final mission is required to finish the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission Breakfast Run. The game takes you to the location and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Unmissable: it is a required story mission.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the big heist missions; follow the mission objectives and the trophy unlocks on completion. Unmissable: it is a required story mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission Child's Play. Follow the objectives and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Unmissable: it is a required story mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission Headliners. Follow the objectives and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Unmissable: it is a required story mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission VCIA Takedown. It takes place at Vice City International Airport; follow the objectives and the trophy unlocks on completion. Unmissable: it is a required story mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Play through the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the objectives and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Unmissable: it is a required story mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats. That means finishing the story, all stranger strands and side missions, and the activities and collectibles that count toward completion. Check the in-game completion percentage after each stage of the roadmap — the last few percent are usually collectibles. Do this last, after everything else is done.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game completion stats.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps across Leonida. Stunt jumps are the ramps marked on the map; land the jump cleanly and it counts. Progress is tracked in the in-game Challenges menu, so you can see your count at any time. The fastest route is to sweep the marked ramps district by district with a fast bike or sports car.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game Challenges menu.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type in the game: a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a shooting range challenge, a drone race, a meditation spot and the rest. The trophy unlocks as soon as the last type is tried — you do not need to win or complete any of them. Use the Activities menu to see which types exist and tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI Activities menu.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. There are 42 challenges in total (the count PlayStation tracks). Go for accuracy over speed: take your time on the first run to learn each course, then replay for gold. Progress per challenge is shown at the range, so you can see which ones are still short of gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI Shooting Range.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations around Leonida. The race locations appear on the map once the activity is available; win one race at every location and the trophy unlocks. Fly low and cut the corners — drone races reward tight lines more than raw speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI Top Fun Drone Races.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road and any other race type all count, as long as each race is a different one. The in-game Challenges menu tracks how many distinct races you have won. Enter races from the map and work through them; you do not need to win the same race twice.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game Challenges menu.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet through the fishing activity — challenge him and out-fish him. Treat it as a one-time opportunity: take the challenge when it is offered rather than leaving it for later, and replay the mission from the pause menu if you lose it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI fishing activity.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade in Leonida. Walk up to an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it to the end — any game counts. The trophy unlocks when the game completes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI arcades.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger and side missions appear on the map as you progress through the story; keep returning to Andy's marker until his strand is done. The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI side missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Keep following Kenton's marker on the map until his strand is done. The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI side missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Keep following Billy's marker on the map until his strand is done. The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI side missions.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the side characters marked on the map, including Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Each strand is several missions; the trophy counts a strand as done when its final mission completes. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick the ones nearest your current story progress.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI side missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Keep following Randy's marker on the map until his strand is done. The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI side missions.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Keep following Tyrone's marker on the map until his strand is done. The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI side missions.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are scenic viewpoints marked once you find them; sit and meditate at each one. Work through them region by region so none is missed — the count is tracked in the in-game Challenges menu.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game Challenges menu.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting requests come through his strand; follow his directions to the animal's area, track it and take it down. The trophy unlocks when the hunt is delivered to Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI hunting.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world. Each set needs every card in it; the in-game collection screen shows which cards of each set you still need. Collect a set, then move to the next; three completed sets unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game collection screen.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the in-world tagging activity — find the spots, tag them and move on. The count is tracked in the in-game Challenges menu. Sweep each district fully before moving on, so you do not have to backtrack for a handful of missed spots.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game Challenges menu.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges in total. Challenges are the tracked goals in the in-game Challenges menu — stunts, races, collectibles, activities and more all count toward the same total. Just playing through the roadmap naturally clears most of them; check the menu near the end to see which easy ones are left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game Challenges menu.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. It needs your partner present, so do it during a story stretch where you are paired up — free roam with a partner is the reliable moment. Break line of sight, hide until the stars flash, then stay out of the search area until they clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI wanted system.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without ever losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route with 3 shops close together, keep the wanted level alive between robberies, and do not let the cops lose you. It needs your partner present, so attempt it while the story still pairs you up.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI wanted system.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Driving or entering a new vehicle model counts it as discovered; the count is tracked in the game. Drive everything you see — traffic, parked cars, bikes, boats — and the total climbs fast. Rare vehicles count the same as common ones, so variety beats hunting.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI in-game tracking.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least 5 enemies close together, then chain the takedowns before it ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout gives you the targets; do not waste it on a single enemy.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI Combat Focus.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. This is tied to a story sequence at the airport — when the moment comes, take the departure the game offers instead of following the obvious exit. It is a one-time moment: if you pass it, replay the mission from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story at VCIA.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and cause chaos with it. Steal or find a Rhino, then use it in free roam — the trophy unlocks from the tank's own mayhem. The military base is the usual place to find one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI free roam.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down and try again. Plan the exit before you go in.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI robberies.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the bigger robbery targets; crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear of the wanted level. Each successful escape counts — you do not need to do all five in one run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI robberies.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, break it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. Any truck counts; the trophy unlocks on the first clean escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI robberies.

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida. The trophy tracks map discovery — drive, fly and sail into each district until the whole map is revealed. The in-game map shows what is still fogged; clear it region by region and the trophy unlocks when the last area is revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI map.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations; hit one operation per gang and the trophy unlocks. The map and your contacts point you to the operations — work through the gangs one by one.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI gang operations.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet story moment on the beachfront — when the scene offers the cocktail, take it. It is a one-time story beat: if you pass it, replay the mission from the pause menu.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story on Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the showroom glass. This happens in a story sequence at a showroom; when the moment comes, put your foot down and go through the window. Unmissable if you follow the mission's lead.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. This is a story beat at the bowling alley — when the scene takes you there, follow the prompt and complete the moment. It unlocks as the scene plays out.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership milestone with mass appeal — a story beat about the duo's rising profile in Leonida. It unlocks as the story's partnership arc reaches its high point. Unmissable: it is tied to story progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: Make the story choices this trophy is tied to. It is a choice-based story beat — when the game offers a decision, pick one and see it through. A choice is a one-time moment: if you want the other outcome, replay the mission from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story choices.

trophies.guide: The name says it: the second time's the charm. This is a story beat where the first attempt fails and the second succeeds — play the scene through and let it happen. It is a one-time story moment; if you pass it, replay the mission from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.guide: A one-off story event that leaves everyone asking what just happened. It is a scripted story moment — play through the scene and the trophy unlocks when the event fires. One-time: replay the mission from the pause menu if you pass it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI story.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl the pins over with a melee drive-by at the bowling alley. While driving past, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle and knock the pins down. It takes a steady hand and a slow pass — line up the alley, keep your speed low and swing as you pass the pins.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI bowling alley.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep feeding bills through your contacts as you earn them — the total is tracked in the game and the trophy unlocks at $250,000 laundered.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI contacts.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything counts. It is cumulative across every shop, so just play and buy what you need; the total is tracked in the game. Big purchases like vehicles and property upgrades push the total up fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI shops.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages appear on the in-game property market; buy each one as you can afford it. Check the property screen to see which garages are still unowned — the trophy unlocks when the last one is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI property market.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, bring them to a Scooter Bros point and register each one — ten registrations unlock the trophy. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive anyway.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA VI Scooter Bros app.
